derivation.operation: For Native15, kappa(z)=betaR*exp(-z/8000)+betaM*exp(-z/1200), betaR=0.00000124062*(lambda_nm/1000)^-4, betaM=(0.04/1200)*(lambda_nm/1000)^-0.8; f=kappa*h^2/(rho^2+(h-z)^2). Expected tap ratio=f(query)/f(node). Synthetic stored J_node=f_node*(1+0.25*r_node/h+z_node/H)*(channel+1); positive P0 radius/altitude moments imply exact restored J_query=f_query*(1+0.25*r_query/h+z_query/H)*(channel+1). No direct-beam attenuation, fitted brightness correction, candidate numerical imports or physical-field oracle.
